description: Update the PublicPath type generation to include CSS entrypoints, ensuring type checking for browser.runtime.getURL works correctly with CSS assets. Currently, only JS and HTML entrypoints are included in the PublicPath type, but CSS entrypoints like content-script-style and unlisted-style should also be recognized.
functional_requirements: Extend the path generation logic to map 'content-script-style' and 'unlisted-style' entrypoints to '.css' extensions in the PublicPath type definitions
Ensure the generated types in .wxt/types/paths.d.ts include CSS paths alongside existing JS and HTML paths
Add an e2e test to verify that CSS paths are correctly included in the generated type definitions
